output.summary: At S1 the picture points at firmware (60% completion, 9 of 11 failed gate criteria, 31% reopen rate), but scope looked flat. S2 reverses that. Forty-seven post-freeze clarification tickets, mostly from Sales for Brightwell, changed 41 stories without re-estimation. Those stories took 3,960 hours against 1,450 estimated. Untouched firmware stories complete at 94%, matching the Halo 3 baseline, and sprints with 3 or more new tickets ran at 41% against 92% with none. The firmware manager asked three times for re-estimation and got no reply. So the flat burn-down hides added work, and firmware is slow because of churn, not weak estimation. Replacing the manager is unjustified. Preferred actions are change control and rescoping with Brightwell, whose actual launch conditions are three features. The accelerator's motive is unproven, so changing the compensation plan now is premature.
